simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תָּאָה (H8376) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תָּאָה (tâʼâh) means to mark off , i.e. (intensively) designate First listed occurrence: Num 34 7.

definitions.full: H8376. taah [ תָּאָה ] verb Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine plural תְּתָאוּ Num 34:7-8 , apparently ye shall mark out (the boundary), but this (and הִתְאַוִּיתֶם 34:10 , v אוה q. v.) very dubious, see Gray, and [ תָּאַר ].
